summary: Galaxy Gaming filed an 8-K reporting a First Amendment to its Credit Agreement with BMO Bank. The amendment permits repurchases of up to $4 million of its stock, funded solely by a termination fee from the terminated merger with Evolution Malta Holding Limited, subject to liquidity and covenant conditions. It also adjusts the Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio and reporting requirements. This is a routine credit agreement amendment, not a standalone special situation; the reference to a prior merger termination fee is context but not the event itself.
